title: Map an ExperimentHoldout onto flag filters via _apply_holdout, not set_holdout directly
answers: How do I set a holdout on an experiment's feature flag filters?
Where does holdout id / exclusion_percentage get written to flag filters?
Adding a new holdout call site in the experiment service
body:
In products/experiments/backend/experiment_service.py, use `_apply_holdout(filters, holdout)` (defined next to the other filter helpers like `_strip_frozen_exposure`) whenever an ExperimentHoldout (or None) must be reflected in flag filters.
- It wraps the facade's plain-value `set_holdout(filters, holdout_id=..., exclusion_percentage=...)` and passes None for both when holdout is None (which clears it).
- Existing callers: `_ensure_feature_flag` (create path) and `_sync_feature_flag_on_update` (both the filters-rebuild branch and the holdout-only `update_flag` branch).
- Do not re-inline `holdout.id if holdout else None` at call sites; a change to how a holdout maps to flag filters belongs inside the helper only.
says: I need to set up a holdout exclusion on the running experiment
Holdout percentage not showing in the experiment's flag configuration
Creating an experiment should apply its holdout to the feature flag
Removing experiment holdout should clear it from the active flag
